[/size][size=3][/size][/color][/url][color=#ff7700][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/color][/center][/b]
[b]Shop Search Bar[/b] adds a small search box to supported shop menus so you can quickly filter the shop list by item name—great for large vanilla inventories and especially useful with modded shops.

[color=#00ffff][b]Features

[/b][/color][list]
[*]Search box shown on supported [b]ShopMenu[/b] shops (vanilla + modded).
[*][b]Modded shop support[/b] via an allow-list: add your shop’s ID/name/token to enable the bar.
[*]Configurable [b]X/Y position offsets[/b] so you can move the bar where you want.
[*]Configurable [b]hotkey[/b] (default: [b]F[/b]) to call out / focus the search box.
[/list]
[youtube]hjIaiGwvFL8[/youtube]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40230/40230-1765584219-24135440.png[/img]



[b][color=#00ffff]How to use

[/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Open a supported shop (e.g., Pierre).

[*]Press [b]F[/b] to call out / focus the search box.

[*][b]Hover your mouse slightly above the search bar[/b], then type the item name (partial matches work).

[*]Clear the text to restore the full shop list.

[/list][b][color=#00ffff]Configuration

[/color][/b][list]
[*][b]Hotkey:[/b] change the focus key (default [b]F[/b]) in GMCM.
[*][b]Force Attach on Hotkey:[/b] enable this and press [b]F[/b] while in that shop—its “identity token” will be logged for you to add to the allow-list.
[*][b]Allowed shop IDs/names:[/b] add tokens (comma/semicolon/newline separated) to support modded shops.
[*][b]Search bar X/Y offset:[/b] move the search bar position.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Shortcut F call out search bar, hover your mouse over to the top of search bar, type in item name, Done!
